<!-- pr-reviewer: 004e43cfe144a8be65cd58e1de271b387ab6843b -->
Needs changes before merge. One test fails when the head merges with current main.

Thank you for the careful law here: the exact sweep verdict, the byte-for-byte Jump fallback, and the refusal pins are the right shape. The code review found no safety blockers.

The result merged with main (built locally, trial merge clean, no textual conflicts):

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| camcraft-motion --test finish3d_gaplink | 5 passed, 1 FAILED |
| camcraft-motion --test finish3d | 55 passed, 33 ignored |
| camcraft-app --test project_roundtrip | 76 passed |
| camcraft-app --test mcp | 23 passed |
| camcraft-app --test golden_cl | 33 passed |
| camcraft-app --test operations | 120 passed, 6 ignored |

The failure:

```
test straight_links_holes_at_the_run_height ... FAILED
assertion `left == right` failed: the retract hop is gone, only clearance stays: [12.0, 20.0]
  left: [12.0, 20.0]
 right: [20.0]
```

crates/motion/tests/finish3d_gaplink.rs:157. On today's main the Straight chain still leaves one retract-plane traverse at z 12.0 over the holed-plate fixture. This lane could not tell which main change interacts; candidates merged since your branch point include #2035 (adaptive stock ring budget) and #2450 (chamfer ride, 7bcc13a4b). Please merge main into the branch, find why the hop stands, and update the law or the pin, with the reason in the commit.

Requested before merge:
1. Fix `straight_links_holes_at_the_run_height` on the merged tree (finish3d_gaplink.rs:157).

Notes (not blocking):
- The verdict law passed its own safety scan pin (straight_links_keep_the_ball_out_of_the_plate). The failure is about link selection, not about a gouge path.
- The serpentine fix and the digest tag discipline (0x4D + variant byte only off the default) read correctly.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
